changeSet.comment: A conversation run stores its owner (account_id) and the ledger position of the question or digest entry that it answers (conversation_id and subject_seq), from its turn. A review run stores none of them. Each turn names its run with the run's owner, so the owner of a run is always the owner of its turn. Each run names the entry at its position, so the entry cannot go or move while the run exists. A turn of an account under erasure that lost its question to an erasure that stopped goes now, with its run: the erasure deletes it anyway. Any other conversation run without a turn and its question or digest stops the migration and names the count. An ended run changes only when its turn moves to another owner.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: When each transaction commits, every conversation run has its turn, in the turn's conversation, and the entry at the run's position is the turn's question or digest. The foreign key sfk_agent_run_stimulus keeps an entry at that position. The check runs when a run is queued or changes its state or position, when a turn changes its status, run, surface or conversation, and when a question or digest entry of a turn changes its position, kind, surface, turn or conversation, or goes: another entry that takes the position satisfies the foreign key, but not this check. Row-level security can hide a turn or an entry from the transaction: the check then fails instead of passing. The function names its tables with the schema, because the owner functions fire it with a search path of pg_catalog only.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: When an absorbed account's conversations move to the account that claimed it, the run of each moved turn takes the claiming account, and the run of each merged turn takes the new position of its question or digest entry in the kept conversation.
